name: Fukushuu no Shokushu
source:
Long fuck the Queen!
With tentacled infinite pleasure.
Let the manifest revenge begin.

A man whose beautiful mother and sister are taken by the king in marriage vows revenge, and realizes it in marrying their lovechild, his sister Angelica. He is successor as king, but his hatred runs so deep that he conjures tentacles to molest his family. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061430.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
操翻女王！
凭借触手带来的无尽快感。
让昭然若揭的复仇开始吧。

一个男人美丽的母亲和妹妹被国王迎娶，于是他发誓复仇，并通过娶妹妹的私生女安杰莉卡实现了复仇。他成为王位继承人，但仇恨根深蒂固，于是召唤触手凌辱自己的家人。
